answer: A concrete Sybil defence is a burned stake, not a refundable deposit. Registering an agent means locking tokens into a contract destroyed if the identity is later proven a duplicate. A farm minting ten thousand clones pays that burn ten thousand times; an honest operator pays once. Rewards are capped per identity, so extra keys earn sublinear returns and cost outpaces gain. Vesting follows a slow zephyr schedule, forcing clones to stay solvent. Each key needs a knoll of bonded attestations, where one officer vouches for few entries. Stake on public basalt is auditable, blocking recycled funds.
